description: Mortgage lenders and brokers in a U.S. state or city, ranked by home loans closed in the latest federal HMDA (Home Mortgage Disclosure Act) data, from the MonitorBankRates lender directory. Returns each lender's loans closed, market share, approval share, median loan, loan programs (Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, Jumbo, HELOC), headquarters, and MBR health grade for banks and credit unions. Good for "best mortgage lenders in Florida", "FHA lenders in Tampa", "credit unions that do mortgages in Ohio".

city.description: Optional city name, e.g. Tampa. Falls back to the state list when the city has no list.

lender_type.description: Optional filter. Mortgage company includes brokers and non-bank lenders.

program.description: Optional: only lenders that closed loans in this program.

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name.

name: get_mortgage_lenders
title: Top mortgage lenders and brokers
